name: Tallyhold
premise: A mobile app that enables independent bottle shops to efficiently perform stocktakes by walking the shelves with their phone and reconciling inventory against till exports.

segments.name: Lean Independents
segments.description: Small independent bottle shops with tight budgets, sensitive to price increases and looking for basic functionality at a low cost.

segments.name: Quality-Focused Shops
segments.description: Independently operated bottle shops that prioritize tool reliability and accuracy but are price sensitive to an extent.

segments.name: Small Chains
segments.description: Smaller regional chains with multiple locations, investing in technology for efficiency, less price sensitive and seeking integration with existing systems.

segments.name: Craft Collectors
segments.description: Shops with a specialty inventory, interested in detailed and customizable reporting, less price sensitive but with specific requirements.
